result.summary: 77-year-old man with acute-on-chronic systolic heart failure and acute kidney injury on CKD III, with atrial fibrillation and chronic anticoagulation. Placement should account for cardiac, renal, electrolyte, and bleeding monitoring; latest creatinine is 1.5 mg/dL, sodium 138 mEq/L, and platelets 171 K/uL. Oxygen at 3 L/min and central venous sampling were documented early in the admission, but ongoing oxygen and central access needs are not confirmed; no invasive ventilation or active IV drips are documented.
result.contact_isolation_reason: Urine cultures grew broadly susceptible Pseudomonas aeruginosa; no multidrug resistance or explicit contact precautions are documented.
lines: Central venous access inferred from 10/09 central venous blood sampling; site and continued presence unconfirmed
